pages.text: $(italic)Attuned to nature magic and wind. Faefolk are ideal for Botania and Ars Nouveau paths but are weakened by iron.$(/italic)$(br2)$(bold)Racial Traits:$(/bold)$(br2)$(bold)Nature Magic$(/bold) — +15% effectiveness with Botania mana tools. +10% Ars Nouveau spell power.$(br2)$(bold)Slow Fall$(/bold) — Permanent Slow Falling. Fall damage reduced by 60%. Feather Fall still stacks.$(br2)$(bold)Iron Weakness$(/bold) — Iron armor and iron tools deal/protect 15% less effectively when worn/held by Faefolk.$(br2)$(bold)Fragile$(/bold) — -10% armor effectiveness from all armor. Even more fragile than Elves.
